propositions: Cumulative error counter streams in observability.sh persist offset before CloudWatch put-metric-data acknowledgement, causing permanent data loss on transient AWS failure.
A failed publish leaves offset advanced while the metric is unacknowledged, so the next run computes zero delta from an already-progressed baseline instead of retrying the accumulated count.
Seven metric streams across six code shapes (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared helpers, G2P) share the same defective offset-acknowledgement pattern.
Offset must advance only after successful CloudWatch publication to preserve the accumulated delta for retry on transient failure.
The whole-script PATH-shim regression test validates that forced AWS failures leave offset byte-identical and subsequent successful runs republish the accumulated delta before advancing offset.
